title: feat(ui): group contradictions by project
author: devin-ai-integration
head: 585071eef223ed5b9d5c8674d12f1eb975d52071
body:
## Summary

`/ui/contradictions` was one flat list with no project information, so a reviewer couldn't tell which project a pair belonged to. This groups pairs by project, with cross-project pairs in their own trailing group.

**API (additive, byte-compatible for existing fields)** — `GET /api/v1/contradictions` rows gain the project of each side:

```ts
interface ContradictionListItem {
  ...existing,
  project_id_a: string | null;   project_name_a: string | null;
  project_id_b: string | null;   project_name_b: string | null;
}
```

Core `listOpenContradictions()` resolves them with two `LEFT JOIN projects` on `knowledge_current.project_id` (`OpenContradiction` gains `projectIdA/NameA/IdB/NameB`); a global entry (no `project_id`) yields `null` on that side. Name falls back to the project path via `COALESCE(name, path)`. No migration.

**UI** — `groupContradictions()` (new pure module `contradiction-groups.ts`): a pair belongs to project P iff both sides have the same non-null `project_id`; anything else (differing ids, or a global side) goes to the single **Cross-project** group, always rendered last. Project groups are ordered by pair count desc, then label. Each group is a collapsible `<section data-testid="contradiction-group">` with an `aria-expanded` header button showing `label (count)`; collapsed state is kept across list refreshes. Cross-project rows additionally show `A: <project> · B: <project>` (Global when null). Row markup and Keep A / Keep B / Keep both flows are unchanged (extracted into `ContradictionRow`).

## Tests
- core `contradiction.test.ts`: same-project pair, differing-project pair, global side → nulls.
- gateway `dashboard-api.test.ts`: new keys present, seeded project id/name on both sides.
- UI: contract + fixture with the new fields; `contradiction-groups.test.ts` (grouping rule, ordering, cross-project last, empty); `contradictions-page.test.tsx` (three groups with counts, collapse/expand + `aria-expanded`, existing keep flows inside groups).
- e2e: `seed.mjs` adds one scratch↔lore pair; new `contradiction-groups.spec.ts`. `browse.spec.ts` row count 12→13 for the extra seeded lore entry.

```
node scripts/ui-deep-link-smoke.mjs    # ok
pnpm --filter @loreai/ui test:e2e      # 103 passed
pnpm test                              # only the 10 pre-existing environmental failures (git-manager proxy remotes, mtime, isVecAvailable, eval-CLI/Sentry stderr) — same set fails on clean main
```
